summary: This bill requires the Treasury Secretary to issue each Social Security beneficiary a legally enforceable certificate that locks in their full monthly benefit amount plus accurate annual cost-of-living adjustments and counts as advance budget authority for payment.

This reinforces and protects existing federal spending obligations rather than cutting them, producing a modest directional effect toward maintaining or expanding spending levels.
